info.title: CardPointers API (observed, reverse-engineered)
info.description: Reconstructed from static analysis of CardPointers 8.1.4 for macOS. Paths from binary string literals; schemas from Swift Codable field metadata. Request bodies and HTTP methods for mutations are inferred. Not an official specification.
